productFit.name: Feisol CT-3472 Elite Rapid 4-Section Carbon Fiber Tripod

productFit.reason: Feisol Europe (feisol.eu) sells the CT-3472 M2 Rapid directly; the maker sells the Mark 2 version, as the English post notes.

localFacts.fact: Lufthansa allows carry-on bags of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm. The Peak Design (39,4 cm) and the Befree Advanced (40 cm) fold shorter than 55 cm; the MT190XPRO3 (59 cm) and the Vanguard (about 72 cm) do not.
Nationalpark Saechsische Schweiz: in the core zone (Kernzone) only marked or signposted paths may be used, so a tripod spot off the trail is not allowed there.
German retailers sell the Befree Advanced lever aluminium kit as MKBFRLA4BK-BH and list 128 cm height and 40 cm pack size.
Feisol sells the CT-3472 M2 Rapid in Europe through feisol.eu, listed at 1,81 kg.

localPainPoints.pain: A light tripod shakes on night/long exposures even in a light wind.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the column down, collapse the thinnest sections first, hang a bag from the hook; thicker 3-section legs (Alta Pro, MT190XPRO3) resist gusts better.

quotes.text: Nach einigen Nachtaufnahmen habe ich nämlich festgestellt, das dieses Stativ mehr wackelt als mir lieb ist und das schon bei sehr wenig Wind.

localPainPoints.pain: Legs set narrow in wind wobble more.
localPainPoints.fix: Spread the legs wide (English post wind fix); extra leg-angle stops help on uneven ground.

quotes.text: Wenn man bei Wind die Beine nicht breit stellt, sondern schmal, wackelt das Stativ eher.

localPainPoints.pain: Landscape trips to windy, wet coasts such as the North Sea with salt water.
localPainPoints.fix: Twist locks pick up grit; rinse the legs after sand or salt (English post link to the beach cleaning guide); flip locks show when they are closed.

quotes.text: vor allem in windigen und feuchten Einsatzgebieten (Nordsee (Salzwasser!)
